# Roleplay Rule 10 - Mentor Rules
The mentor roles are a group of personnel that, in order to select, require elevated time requirements (over 100 hours of playtime) within a given department and its roles. These are the [color=#846326]Bosun[/color], the [color=#c8a404][bold]Foreman[/bold][/color], the [color=#42636d][bold]Medicus[/bold][/color], the [color=#cc74fc]Professor[/color], and the [color=#ba292c][bold]Sergeant[/bold][/color]. They are expected to teach new players and advise their department.
Because mentor roles are designed to teach, [bold]should you play a mentor role, you are expected to teach first above all, even if you are an antagonist.[/bold]
Additionally, you are held to a higher roleplay standard and expected to know how to competently carry out your department’s duties. [bold]Failure to do so may result in a role ban.[/bold]
Set a good example for new players.
